Two friends, a Middle Eastern woman and an African American woman went clothes shopping together. The Middle Eastern woman could only shop at stores that carried larger sizes while the African American woman could wear sizes carried in most stores. Who wore clothing sizes that were available at most stores?
A. The African American woman
B. Can't answer
C. The Middle Eastern woman
